acceptanceCriteria.command: git show <merge-commit-sha> -- README.md  (equivalently: legion gh -- pr diff <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke shows README.md as the only changed file with exactly the one added line); CI: `ci` and `fail-on-demand` workflows green on the PR head.
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A PR against sjawhar/legion-smoke appends the line `Legion Stage 3 smoke proof.` to README.md and changes no other file.
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: Touching a second file (or omitting the appended line) makes `pr diff` show a non-README.md change or no README change -> proof fails.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: GitHub pull request against sjawhar/legion-smoke and the merged main branch (the real repository, the production-like surface for a docs change).

acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- pr diff <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke shows README.md as the only changed file; the review thread that requested the extra line is resolved (isResolved:true via gh api graphql).
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: If review asks for one more appended line to README.md, the implementer adds it in the same PR and the PR still touches only README.md.
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: An extra line landing in any file other than README.md -> pr diff shows a second changed file -> proof fails.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: GitHub pull request review threads and PR diff on sjawhar/legion-smoke.

errorHandling: README.md missing at root -> stop and report to the architect; do NOT create a different file.
Review requests changes to any non-README.md file -> escalate to the architect; do NOT widen the change.
steps: Confirm README.md exists at the repository root of $LEGION_WORKSPACE (it does; verified by the planner).
Append exactly one line `Legion Stage 3 smoke proof.` at the end of README.md (preserve trailing newline; no other edits).
Commit the change, push the issue branch legion/S394547882-1, and open the PR with body line `Dispatch: S394547882-1`.

If review requests exactly one more appended line to README.md, add it in the same PR (pre-approved as in scope by spec.md v2); any request to change a different file is out of scope and must be escalated to the architect.

integration.postMerge: Implementer verifies on main: `git show <merge-commit> -- README.md` shows exactly the one appended line on main (production check for a docs change).

implement: none: reviewed the system-prompt <skills> list (all Legion workflow skills plus dispatch/envoy/ce-simplify-code) and the repo (no AGENTS.md, only .github CI stubs); a one-line append to README.md is a docs-only edit with no runtime code, so no engineering/build skill applies and ce-simplify-code (runtime-code-only) is out of scope.
legion-worker: the implementer runs as a Legion phase worker and must follow it for workspace binding, jj/push procedure, PR open, and E2E proof discipline.
review: none: reviewed the <skills> list and the repo — this is a docs-only PR, so the thermonuclear-deep-review/thermonuclear-code-quality passes are skipped per legion-worker and no repository review skill applies; review is standard PR thread + CI/E2E verification.
legion-worker: the reviewer must follow it for one-review-per-round discipline, thread disposition, and verifying CI/E2E facts against GitHub.
test: none: reviewed the <skills> list and the repo — there is no test framework, test suite, or repository testing skill; verification is `git show <merge> -- README.md` / `pr diff` on GitHub, which needs no test skill.
legion-worker: the tester must follow it to verify the implementer's proof, record implementerProof in .legion/test.json, and add its own E2E line.

risks: The two CI workflows (`ci`, `fail-on-demand`) run on push/PR; `fail-on-demand` fails only if a `.fail-me` file is present — do not add one.
Repeated appended proof lines already exist in README.md; append the new line at EOF only, do not edit existing lines.
summary: Append the single line `Legion Stage 3 smoke proof.` to README.md at the repository root of sjawhar/legion-smoke, changing no other file, delivered as one pull request through the full plan/implement/test/review/merge flow on the issue's smoke branch. testEvidence.implementer: Open the PR, let CI (`ci`, `fail-on-demand`) run green at head, and record `git show <head> -- README.md` (one added line, README.md only) plus a negative control as the E2E (implementer) proof line and .legion/implement.json proof array.
testEvidence.merger: After approval on a head carrying no .legion/, run `legion threads resolve`, confirm no changes above the approved head, publish READY.
testEvidence.review: Docs-only PR: thermonuclear-deep-review and thermonuclear-code-quality passes are skipped (no runtime code); reviewer verifies CI/Threads/E2E facts against GitHub and confirms README.md is the only changed file.
testEvidence.tester: Independently re-run `git show <head> -- README.md` / `legion gh -- pr diff <n>` to confirm README.md is the sole changed file with the exact added line, verify the implementer's proof, and record E2E (tester) in .legion/test.json.
